370: ## [0.13.37] - 2026-11-25
371: 
372: ### Fixed / 修复
373: 
374: - **A session that never ran `/grok` no longer shows the switch as on / 没打过 `/grok` 的新会话，开关不再显示「开」** —
375:   The route folds your configured default into what it answers for a session with no record, but the block intake reads the session's own record, so that session showed a green "On" and refused every block with `mode-off`. The switch now says `Not on · not set yet` in that state, with an unlit pill and a hollow lamp, and one click turns the session on for real (it writes `enabled: true`). The route, `/grok status` and the settings page still answer the effective value — the two are meant to differ, see D-154.
376:   / 对于没有任何记录的会话，路由会把你配置的默认值折进答复里，但接单台只认会话自己的记录，于是那种会话的开关显示绿色「开」、接单却全被拒成 `mode-off`。现在这种状态下开关显示「未开 · 还没设过」、灰胶囊、空心指示灯，点一下才真正打开（写的是 `enabled: true`）。路由、`/grok status` 和设置页照旧报有效值——两边本来就该不一样，见 D-154。
377: - **The rate-limit (429) switch finally has a control on the settings page / 设置页里那个限流（429）开关终于有控件了** — `switchOnRateLimit` was the one declared field out of fourteen that had a label, a hint and a schema entry in both languages and no control at all: you could read that it existed and still not change it. It now has a real row in the "Who does what" card, right after the guardian and before the five role chains: a switch, its on/off state word, and the hint underneath. The default is still on and nothing about the behaviour changed — a 429 still advances the chain and switching it off still leaves the 429 on its route for the task retry. No schema change, no new copy keys, no change to the defaults.
378:   / `switchOnRateLimit` 曾是 14 个声明字段里唯一一个「中英都有 label 和提示、schema 里也有、页面上就是没有控件」的字段：读者能看到它存在，却改不了它。现在它在「谁来干」那张卡里有了一行真的控件，位置在守卫之后、五条角色链之前：一个开关、它的开/关状态词，下面一行提示。默认值仍然是开，行为一个字没改——限流（429）仍然换到链上的下一个模型，关掉之后 429 仍然留在原路由交给任务重试。不改 schema、不加文案键、不动默认值。
379: - **`/grok on` now says what it really does / `/grok on` 现在说的是实话** — The command used to answer that every message would run the full plan→execute→verify workflow, which nothing has done since `0.13.35`. It now says the truth in two short sentences: turning it on lets the model commission reviewed blocks of work in that session, and messages themselves are not turned into a workflow. The off answer, the stored record and the intake's own admission rule are unchanged.
380:   / 以前 `/grok on` 会回答「每条消息现在都跑完整的 plan→execute→verify 工作流」，而从 `0.13.35` 起没有任何东西会这么做。现在它用两句短话说实话：打开之后，这个会话里模型可以把工作拆成可复核的块来下单；消息本身不会被变成一次工作流。关闭时的回答、存下来的记录，以及接单台自己的准入规则都没有改。
381: - **The settings page and both READMEs now say what the switch really does / 设置页与两个 README 现在说的是实话** — The first group on the settings page was titled "Master switch" with the field "Work hard by default", and the status line promised "the workflow tool is available" — none of which has been true since `0.13.35`. The group is now "Session default", the field "Default before /grok", and the status line says what a session with no `/grok` record reports, adding that opening a reviewed block still needs that session to run `/grok` itself. The `/grok on` receipt gained the same missing premise: the intake's tools only exist while the block intake is switched on. Both READMEs drop the deleted `auto`/`full` mode selector and describe the five groups the page really renders, including the one-line hints on the two budget fields and the upgrade card at the bottom.
382:   / 设置页第 1 组以前叫「总开关」，字段叫「默认下大力气」，状态行写着「工作流工具可用」——从 `0.13.35` 起这些都不再成立。现在这组叫「会话默认」，字段叫「没打 `/grok` 时的默认」，状态行说的是「还没打过 `/grok` 的会话报什么」，并补上那句缺了的前提：要在这个会话里开可复核的块，还得这个会话自己打一句 `/grok`。`/grok on` 的回执也补上了同一个前提：接单台的工具只在它打开时才存在。两个 README 删掉了早就删除的 `auto`/`full` 模式选择器，改成页面真正渲染的五组，包括两个预算字段各自的一行说明和最底下那张升级卡片。
383: 
384: ### Upgrade note / 升级须知
385: 
386: - **Delete the leftover `mode:` and `legacyGate:` lines from your profile before you upgrade / 升级前先把档案里 `mode:` 与 `legacyGate:` 那两行都删掉** —
387:   If your profile's patch file still carries a `mode:` line or a `legacyGate:` line under the `grok-workflow` entry, the plugin will refuse to
388:   activate that row after the upgrade and the workflow simply disappears from the interface. Either line on its own is enough to do it, so
389:   deleting only one of them still leaves the row refusing to activate. Nothing is lost — your settings and records are untouched — but you have
390:   to restart with both lines gone for the plugin to come back. So: **before** upgrading, open `<your profile directory>/cordis.patch.yml`, find
391:   the `grok-workflow` entry, delete the leftover `mode:` line **and** the leftover `legacyGate:` line beneath it, save, then upgrade. Both keys
392:   were removed together with the old front desk, so a stored value is rejected as an unknown key. If neither line is present in your file, there
393:   is nothing to do. We have not edited anybody's profile for you.
394:   / 如果你的档案补丁文件里，`grok-workflow` 那一行下面还写着 `mode:` 或 `legacyGate:`，升级之后这一行会**拒绝激活**，症状就是工作流从界面上消失。
395:   这两个键留下任何一个都会这样，只删掉其中一个，那一行仍然拒绝激活；什么都没丢——设置和记录都还在——但必须把两行都删掉再起，插件才会回来。
396:   做法：**升级之前**打开 `<你的档案目录>/cordis.patch.yml`，找到 `grok-workflow` 那一行，把它下面写着 `mode:` 的那一行**整行删掉**，
397:   再把写着 `legacyGate:` 的那一行也**整行删掉**，保存，然后升级。这两个键在 0.13.35 就随旧前台一起删了，存着值会被当未知键拒绝。
398:   如果你的文件里这两行都没有，什么都不用做。我们**没有**替你改过任何档案。

lines.text: # Changelog / 更新日志
Notable user-facing changes are recorded here in English and Simplified Chinese.
用户可见的功能和修复会在这里以英文和简体中文记录。
## [Unreleased]
### Added / 新增
- **Saying "form a team" now comes with a hard instruction on that turn — and that is all it does / 你说「开团」时，那一轮会多一句硬指令——仅此而已** —
When a message asks for a team — Chinese `开团` / `组队` / `分工`, or English `form a team` / `split the work` / `delegate`
(whole words; `delegated` does not match) — and grok mode is on, one fixed instruction is appended to the user message
handed to the model. Your own words are untouched: it is the same message, with one extra block at its end.
**It does show in the UI.** The instruction is part of the message the model is handed, so it appears in the transcript
and inside the message bubble (the sidebar title is truncated). An earlier draft of this note promised "nothing extra in
the UI"; that was measured false on a real machine and is not repeated here.
**If the model ignores it, the turn answers normally — no refusal, no dead turn.** This version carries no gate: real-machine
rounds showed the old refusal ended turns with no answer at all, so that half was deleted rather than retuned.
**And nothing enforces the split**, because the plugin never gets told that a turn ended: the instruction is a lever,
not a rule.
At most one instruction per matched message, `/grok off` disables it, and `forceTeamRouting` (default on) is the switch.
**Upgrade note: nothing to prepare — it is on by default, and no existing key, default or stored record changes.**
/ 当一句话是在要团队——中文 `开团` / `组队` / `分工`，或英文 `form a team` / `split the work` / `delegate`（整词命中，
`delegated` 不算）——并且 grok 模式开着时，插件会往交给模型的那条用户消息尾部追加一句固定硬指令。
你写的字原样保留：还是同一条消息，只是末尾多一个文本块。
**界面上是看得见的。** 这句指令属于交给模型的那条消息，所以它会出现在记录里，也会出现在消息气泡里（侧栏标题会被截断）。
这份说明早先写过「界面上不会多出任何东西」，真机实测是错的，不再这么写。
**模型如果无视它，这一轮就照常作答——不拒绝，也不会出现没有答案的一轮。** 这个版本里没有闸：真机几轮测下来，
原来那半会把回合终止成「没有答案」，所以那半是删掉的，不是调软的。
**而且没有任何东西强制执行拆活**，因为插件根本收不到「这一轮结束」的消息：这句指令是一根杠杆，不是一条规则。
每条命中的消息最多一句指令，`/grok off` 会关掉它，开关是 `forceTeamRouting`（默认开）。

what a key needs — so the dead-route table keeps counting only timeouts, dropped connections, 5xx and the 429 the operator's switch keeps on
its route. What the user sees: a run whose gateway refuses the first call with a key error finishes instead of falling back or re-running

promised a channel that belongs to a run that already ended. A demand queued with `grok_steer` while the run works is merged into

counted in the log instead of vanishing. Since 0.13.35 nothing opened that queue, so `grok_steer` always answered "this block has
no workflow running" and a mid-run demand could not be merged at all. The `replan` switch still decides whether a channel exists:
off means every message is its own round, exactly as before, and a run that is given no conversation has no channel.

the cost the switch always described: a run with several waves spends one planner-route call per boundary (at most four per run),
because "nothing was queued" is only knowable by asking.

420:   to restart with both lines gone for the plugin to come back. So: **before** upgrading, open `<your profile directory>/cordis.patch.yml`, find

424:   / 如果你的档案补丁文件里，`grok-workflow` 那一行下面还写着 `mode:` 或 `legacyGate:`，升级之后这一行会**拒绝激活**，症状就是工作流从界面上消失。
425:   这两个键留下任何一个都会这样，只删掉其中一个，那一行仍然拒绝激活；什么都没丢——设置和记录都还在——但必须把两行都删掉再起，插件才会回来。
426:   做法：**升级之前**打开 `<你的档案目录>/cordis.patch.yml`，找到 `grok-workflow` 那一行，把它下面写着 `mode:` 的那一行**整行删掉**，
427:   再把写着 `legacyGate:` 的那一行也**整行删掉**，保存，然后升级。这两个键在 0.13.35 就随旧前台一起删了，存着值会被当未知键拒绝。
428:   如果你的文件里这两行都没有，什么都不用做。我们**没有**替你改过任何档案。
429: 
430: ### Changed / 变更
431: 
432: - **The switch at the bottom of the message box is now called the workflow switch, and says only on or off / 对话框底部那个开关现在就叫「工作流开关」，只说是开还是关** —
433:   Its label read `Workflow` in English and `workflow总开关` in Chinese, and its on-state read `On · full crew` / `开 · 全员模式` — the name of a mode that no longer
434:   exists, because the old front desk was deleted in 0.13.35. The label is now `Workflow switch` / `工作流开关` and the state is just `On` / `开`, set against
435:   `Off` / `关`. Nothing else moves: the same session record, the same request, the same click, the same three ways of saying off. Only the words on screen.
436:   / 标签原来是英文 `Workflow`、中文 `workflow总开关`，开着的时候读 `On · full crew` / `开 · 全员模式`——那个「全员模式」在 0.13.35 删掉旧前台之后就不存在了，
437:   屏幕上却还写着。现在标签统一叫 `Workflow switch` / `工作流开关`，状态只有 `开`，与 `关` 相对。别的都没动：同一条会话记录、同一个请求、同一次点击、
438:   同样那三种说法表示关。变的只是屏幕上那几个字。
439: 
440: ### Removed / 移除
441: 
442: - **Dead code, not features: the last unused exports left by the 0.13.35 deletion are gone / 删掉的是死代码，不是功能：0.13.35 那次删除留下的最后一批没人用的导出已经清掉** —
443:   Nothing you can do produces a different result. The text renderer that relayed a report into the turn, and the front desk's
444:   single-call path, lost their last callers when the old front desk was deleted in 0.13.35; this version removes them, together with
445:   the private constants and record types only they read, and rewrites the twelve test files that still reached for them. Nineteen
446:   checks went with them, each one measuring a mechanism that no longer exists; everything else in those files is unchanged and still
447:   runs. No configuration key, tool, message wording or settings-page field moves, and nothing installs or upgrades differently.
448:   / 你能做的事，没有一件结果会变。把报告转述进这一轮的那段文字渲染，和旧前台那条单次调用路径，在 0.13.35 删掉旧前台时就失去了最后
449:   一个调用者；这一版把它们删掉，连同只有它们在读的私有常量与记录类型，并把仍然够到它们的十二个测试文件改写过来。十九条检查项随之
450:   删除，每一条量的都是一个已经不存在的机制；这些文件里其余的用例一字未改，照旧在跑。配置键、工具、消息措辞、设置页上的字段一个都没动，
451:   安装与升级的步骤也没有任何不同。
452: 
453: ## [0.13.35] - 2026-11-25
454: 
455: ### Added / 新增
456: 
457: - **The workflow settings are also a `Workflow` entry in the Host's Settings panel / 工作流设置同时成为宿主设置面板左列的「Workflow」一项** —
458:   The same settings page that the Plugins card opens is now registered a second time in the Settings panel's left column, as a peer of
459:   通用设置 / 模型 / 内置插件. One component, one data face, no page changes; the entry is named by the single word `Workflow` in both
460:   languages, with no description line, and the Plugins card stays — one page, two ways in. / 插件卡片打开的那个设置页，现在同时注册到
461:   宿主设置面板的左列，与「通用设置 / 模型 / 内置插件」平级。同一个组件、同一份数据面，页面本身没有改动；入口名两个语言都只有一个词
462:   `Workflow`，不带说明文字；插件页的卡片保留——一个页面，两条进来。
463: - **A heartbeat listener that can stand on its own / 一个能独立接管的心跳监听** — The plugin's own listener is what reviews the brakes and
464:   can stop a beat by itself: one listener owns them on every load, installed even with the block intake switched off. It keeps its own
465:   small record of a beat — what became of that beat — and never writes over the intake's record, which says which blocks still owe work.
466:   It is installed when the plugin loads, not a live toggle.
467:   / 复核刹车、能自己停掉一拍的是插件自己的那个监听：每次载入都只有这一个，接单台关着时也照样装上。它自己留一小行记录——这一拍
468:   怎么了——绝不覆盖接单台那行「还欠哪几个块」。它在插件载入时安装，不是热开关。
469: 
470: ### Changed / 变更
471: 
472: - **The role that splits a block is now called the dispatcher / 「包工头」改叫「调度」** — The delegated agent that splits one block into
473:   subagents, accepts their results and writes no code is now named the dispatcher, in the tool descriptions, the preview line and the
474:   refusal messages alike. Nothing else moved: a block row still records `execution: "foreman"`, and the L1 dispatcher on the task board
475:   keeps its own name. / 把一块活拆给子代理、收结果、自己不写代码的那个角色，现在叫「调度」，工具说明、预览那一行和拒绝消息里都改了。
476:   其余没动：块账本里照样记 `execution: "foreman"`，任务板那一层的 L1 大管家还是它自己的名字。
477: - **Your messages are no longer intercepted by default / 默认不再有人拦你的消息** — An ordinary message goes straight to the model: no
478:   front-desk reply is inserted, and what you typed reaches the model word for word. The old front desk is gone, not merely switched off —
479:   no profile can bring it back. / 普通一句话直接到模型：中间不再插一条前台的转述，你打的字逐字到达模型。旧前台是删掉了，不是改成
480:   关着——没有档案能把它装回来。
481: - **The block tools refuse a session that has not turned grok mode on / 没开 grok 模式的会话，块工具会拒绝** — Ordering a block in a
482:   session that never turned the mode on is now refused, with the reason and the next step in the refusal itself, instead of going ahead.
483:   Turn the mode on first. / 在没打开 grok 模式的会话里开块，现在会被拒绝，拒绝里就写着原因和下一步，而不是先干起来。
484:   先打开模式再开块。
485: - **One listener owns the heartbeat brakes on every load / 每次载入都只有一个监听管刹车** — The listener that reviews the brakes and can
486:   stop a beat is installed even when the block intake is switched off, so a scheduled loop the brakes have stopped stays stopped instead of
487:   running on with nobody left to stop it. / 复核刹车、能停掉一拍的监听，接单台关着时也会装上：被刹车停过的定时循环还是停着，
488:   不会变成没人管、接着跑。
489: 
490: ### Removed / 移除
491: 
492: - **The old front desk is gone, together with the two keys that configured it — delete those keys before you upgrade, or the row will

726:   the board's exclusive lock file, re-reads the store, checks the compare-and-swap guard against
727:   the file, applies, and persists — exactly one claimer wins, the loser gets a version conflict
728:   naming both versions, and no row is lost. A writer killed while holding the lock leaves it
729:   behind; a lock older than the stale window (5 s) is treated as abandoned and removed, so a

758: ## [0.13.30] - 2026-11-24

760: ### Fixed / 修复

762: - **One report's two diagnostics views now say the same thing / 同一份报告的两个诊断视图现在说同一句话** —
763:   Ops opens two machine views of one report while diagnosing: the diagnostics block the tool surface prints, and the machine ledger a delivery carries when that switch is on. They had drifted apart. The ledger showed no dead routes and no per-call child budget at all, it merged this run's own full lane with another run's busy hint under one heading, and the same error read as two different rows because only one view kept the failure category. The ledger now renders the report's own blocks: a dead-route block naming the route, the transport family and the streak; the child-budget line, so a hung child can be told apart from the run's own deadline; two separate overflow headings, one for this run's cap and one for another live run's approximate hint; and error rows that keep the category and the same message bound in both views. A routing entry that recorded only a wait and named no lane is no longer printed as `no lane named`: the report never showed it, and the ledger no longer invents a row for it. The ledger's own length clamp also stopped eating its tail: the closing lines (why the run stopped, and what the watchdog saw) are reserved before an overlong body is cut, so they survive the truncation instead of being the first thing lost. Both new labels are scrubbed from the human answer like every other ledger label.
764:   / 诊断一份报告时，运维会同时打开两个机器视图：工具界面打印的诊断块，以及交付里打开开关后带的机器台账。这两个视图跑偏了——台账里根本没有死路由，也没有每次子调用的预算，还把「这一轮自己满载」和「另一个 run 说这条忙」并成一个标题，同一条错误在两边读出来是两行不同的字（只有一边留着失败类别）。现在台账渲染的就是报告自己的块：死路由块（写明哪条路、死于哪类传输故障、连续几次）、子调用预算行（这样「子代理挂住」和「整轮时限到了」才区分得开）、两个分开的溢出标题（一个是这一轮自己的上限，一个是另一个在跑的 run 给的大致提示）、以及两边都保留类别和同样长度上限的错误行。只记了等待时间、没点名任何道的路由条目不再印成 `no lane named`：报告从来不显示它，台账也不再为它编一行。台账自己的长度上限也不再吃掉尾巴：收尾那两行（为什么停的、守卫看到了什么）在切掉超长正文之前就预留好了，所以它们不会被截断吞掉。这两个新标签和人话答案里其它台账标签一样会被清理掉。

767: 
768: - **The release gate stopped failing on a busy machine / 发版门禁不再因为机器忙就红** —
769:   Two gate cases failed intermittently under load: both asserted the moment the background round *started*, while the gate keeps that session's message channel open until the report is actually delivered — so a message arriving inside that window joined the running round instead of being answered by the front desk, and the case failed with a receipt a user would read as a product bug. Both now wait for the round to *land* (report in, channel gone) through a helper that holds its own timer and fails by name after 15 seconds, instead of the 1-second default that was the real fault. 772: - **Measured on a real run: a route that hangs costs one call, and later tasks never pay for it again / 真机复核：挂住的路只按次数付钱，后面的事不再为它买单** —
773:   Before shipping, a five-task run was measured on an isolated home against a route that accepts the request and then never answers, placed ahead of two live routes. The hung route was called three times in the whole run: twice by the first task (its own two attempts), and never again by tasks two through five, which all landed on a live route. Every hung call was settled by the run's own 45-second child budget (44.65–44.93 s at the endpoint, the remainder being the child's own startup) — never left open, never closed by another watchdog. The third call is the transport layer re-sending the first attempt's orphaned request 300 s later, byte-for-byte the same body: that is the provider's client asking again, not this plugin. Two independent rounds produced the same shape. Evidence: `.rsi/evidence/soak-hang-shape-2026-11-24/`.

776: ## [0.13.29] - 2026-11-24
777: 
778: ### Fixed / 修复
779: 
780: - **A plan is asked for again instead of being given up on / 计划不再因为一次格式错或一次 503 就降级** —
781:   A planning call that came back without a usable plan used to end the run's split immediately: the run degraded to the structural fallback, which can never report the objective as completed, so a child that answered with prose instead of a structured result, or a planning route that refused or hung, cost the whole round its plan. Planning now asks twice more, and neither ask is a retry. A form gap (no structured result, or a plan the shape gate rejects) is re-asked once in the same planning call — the rule the worker and the verifier already followed — with the rejection named in the prompt. A transport death (timeout, dropped connection, a 5xx, a 429 the switch does not keep on its route) re-fires the plan once, on a route this call has not paid for yet: the route that hung is not waited on twice, and with nothing left to try a refusal is repeated once while a hang goes straight to the fallback. The child-call budget now counts those two rescue calls, so a rescued run cannot be aborted at the moment it recovers.
782:   / 规划调用没有可用计划时，过去整个计划当场作废：整轮退化成结构性兜底，而兜底计划永远不可能报告目标已完成——所以子代理答完只说了话、计划过不了形状闸门、或者规划那条路由拒绝/挂死，代价都是整轮没有计划。现在规划会多问两次，两次都不算重试：格式错（没有结构化结果，或计划过不了形状闸门）在同一次规划调用里重交一次（执行与检查两条腿早就这么做），提示词里写明被拒原因；传输死（超时、连接断开、服务商 5xx、勾选框没留住的 429）换路重打一次，只落在这一腿还没付过的路由上——挂死的那条不会被等第二次，路都试完了遇到拒绝会原路再打一次，遇到挂死才直接落兜底。子调用预算把这两次补救也算进去了，所以被救回的一轮不会在最关键的时刻因为预算上限被掐断。
783: 
784: - **A judge that died of a bad route no longer makes the worker do the job again / 判定那一步死于坏路时，不再让干活的那一步重做一遍** —
785:   When the verifier (or the supervisor) never answered because the route carrying it timed out, dropped the connection, answered 5xx, or answered a 429 that the switch policy moves off, the attempt used to fail and the retry re-ran the WORKER — the expensive leg — even though the work was still there and only the verdict was missing. The run now asks that same judging leg once more inside the same attempt, with the executor result unchanged, so a verdict that never arrived costs one judge call instead of a full redo: no retry is spent, no extra attempt row appears, and the worker's result stays. The gate is the run's own "this route is dead" evidence; a missing structured result keeps its one free form resubmit and is not treated as a death, a judge that actually said "fail" is an answer and is never re-asked, a setup fault still stops the attempt, and a 429 counts only when the switch policy says a rate-limited route should move on — a 429 the switch keeps on its route means "busy now" and stays a plain retry. The attempt row now records when this rescue happened, and the child-call ceiling pays for the extra walk (a worker at most 2 calls per attempt, each judging leg at most 3), with the load-time backstop raised from 600 to 1000 calls per task so every legal chain combination still loads.
786:   / 检查者（或监督者）那条路超时、连接被断开、回 5xx，或者回了一个「按勾选框策略该换人」的 429 时，它根本没给出判定；过去这一次尝试就算失败，重试会把**干活的那一步**（最贵的那一步）整个重跑一遍——而活是好的，缺的只是一个判定。现在这一轮会在同一次尝试里，把同一个判定步骤再问一次，执行结果原样不动：一个没到手的判定只花一次判定调用，而不是一次全量重做——不消耗重试次数、不多出一条尝试记录、干活的结果留着。闸门用的是这一轮自己的「这条路死了」证据；「没交结构化结果」仍然保留它那一次免费补交、不算死亡；真的判了「不通过」的那是答案、不会再问；配置/预算类的硬故障仍然直接停；429 只在勾选框说「限流就换人」时才算——勾选框把这条件路留着时，429 的意思是「现在忙」，仍然只是普通重试。尝试记录里会写明发生过这条救援，子代理调用上限也把多出来的一趟算进去了（干活的最多 2 趟、每个判定最多 3 趟），载入期的总闸从 600 抬到 1000，所以任何合法链路组合都仍然装得上。
787: 
788: - **A refused key is reported as a refused key, and no longer pays a pointless resend / 密钥被拒就写成密钥被拒，不再白补交一次** —
789:   When the gateway refused a child with 401 or 403, the run recorded it as a formatting mistake and the report only corrected that wording after the last call — and before that, the task had already paid one same-attempt resubmit that the same key was going to refuse again. A refusal (401/403, an unknown model) now travels to the running workflow the same way a transport death does, carrying the provider's own words, so the attempt ends where it should: the task moves on with the real cause on the row, and there is no resend. It still never marks the route as down — a refused key needs a key, not a different route, so the dead-route table keeps its four transport families and this class is deliberately not one of them. A cancellation and a real format gap are untouched: they keep their one free resubmit.
790:   / 网关用 401 或 403 拒绝子代理时，这一轮过去把它写成「格式不对」，而且报告要等最后一次调用之后才把措辞改回来——在那之前，任务已经为它白付了一次同次补交，而同一个密钥照样会被再拒一次。现在这类拒绝（401/403、模型不存在）和传输层死因走同一条路回到正在跑的工作流，并带着服务商自己的原话，于是这次尝试停在该停的地方：任务换路往下走，失败行写的是真因，也不会再补交。它仍然不会把那条路由记成「这条路挂了」——密钥被拒要的是换 key，不是换路，所以死路由表仍然只收四个传输族，这一类是故意不收的。被取消和真正的格式错一点没动：它们仍然保留那一次免费补交。

- **A run that did not finish now comes back with its complete machine record attached / 没跑完的一轮，

objective, what was confirmed, what was left open, and the final answer. Everything else the run captured —
which plan it used and how it split the work, the wave partition, every attempt with its outcome, the
verifier's per-criterion judgments and the evidence it looked at, the test commands that ran, the full
trail of child calls and the routes they used, the dead routes, the limits in force and the chains
configured for all five roles — was in the structured record but never in the text a reader ends up
holding. Now it is: when a run ends `partial` or `failed`, the answer is followed by a section titled
"Technical audit trail" that prints that record in full, and ends with "Audit trail complete." so a
reader can tell a whole record from a cut one. A run that completes is unchanged, byte for byte — the
trail is an addition for the reader who has something to investigate, not a new shape for every answer.
The trail is a bounded copy, never the record itself: the structured result stays canonical, and a
record too large for one message ends with a line naming the bound and pointing at that result instead
of stopping silently. Nothing is stored twice and nothing new is written anywhere.

The boundary replan prompt used to end with "Answer with the structured result only", while this runtime
records a structured result only when the child calls the result tool. A child that read the sentence
literally answered in prose, nothing was recorded, the boundary was counted as refused, and the new demand
it had just folded in was thrown away with the plan left untouched. The prompt now says outright that the
tool call is what counts and gives the shape to submit; and if a boundary call still comes back without a
structured result, the same boundary asks once more for the decision it already made — the same rescue the
worker and the summary draft already had — without spending a retry or opening a new boundary. If that
second ask comes back empty too, the merge is refused exactly as before and the plan is untouched.
/ 边界再规划的提示词以前最后一句是「只回答结构化结果」，而这套运行时只有在子代理真的调用结果工具时才记录
结构化结果。照着这句话理解的子代理就只用正文回答，什么也没被记录，这个边界被算成「拒绝」，它刚刚并进计划的
新需求随计划一起被丢掉，计划原样不动。现在提示词直说「要调用工具提交」并给出提交的形状；万一某个边界调用还是
只回了正文，同一个边界会再问一次、要它把已经做出的决定交上来——执行代理和汇总稿早就有这条补交通道——既不花
重试额度，也不开新边界。补交也交不上，就照旧拒绝，计划一行不动。
### Added / 新增
- **The settings page can now check and install the newest release itself / 设置页现在能自己检查并安装最新版本** —
The version card used to name the newest release and then hand the reader a command to paste into a
terminal; it could not act on its own answer. It now can: one button checks, and if a strictly newer
published release exists and this plugin host is able to install, the same button installs it in place,
through the plugin manager's own channel. The card has four states — checking, installing, up to date,
and failed — and a failed install shows what failed and offers to read again rather than repeating the
same request blindly. The installation is pinned to the release's exact tag (never `latest`, a branch,
or a range), the version shown afterwards is the one read back from the profile rather than the one that
was requested, and an install that fails or lands on a different version is rolled back to what was
there before, with the answer saying only what a second read-back proves. The page cannot name the
package it installs and cannot install anything that is not a published release of this repository:
only a release tag this repository actually publishes, strictly newer than what is installed, is
accepted. Nothing installs by itself — no check and no install runs when the page opens — and nothing
reloads: the card says outright that a refresh is what activates the new build, and the copyable command
stays there for anyone who would rather run it by hand, following the host's reading of the newest
release rather than a version frozen into the shipped page.
/ 版本卡以前只会说出最新版本，再给一条命令让你自己贴进终端——它没法按自己给的答案动手。现在可以了：一个按钮做检查，
如果确实有更新的已发布版本、且这台宿主能装，同一个按钮就地在插件管理器自己的通道里装上。卡片有四个状态——检查中、
安装中、已是最新、失败——装失败会写清失败原因并给「重新读取」，而不是盲目重发同一个请求。安装钉在那一版的发布标签上
（不用 `latest`、不用分支、不用范围），装完显示的版本是从 profile 里读回来的那一个，不是请求里写的那个；装失败、或
装成了别的版本，会回滚到装之前的样子，回执只说第二次读盘能证明的事。页面既不能自己指定要装哪个包，也装不了不是本仓库
发布版的东西：只接受本仓库真的发布过、且严格新于当前已装版本的发布标签。它不会自己装——页面打开时既不检查也不安装
——也不会自己刷新：卡片会直说「刷新页面新版本才生效」，可复制的命令仍然留在那儿给愿意手跑的人，并且跟随宿主读到的最新
版本，不再跟着页面里写死的那一版走。
### Fixed / 修复
- **Two workers can no longer both claim the same task / 同一个任务不会再被两个 worker 同时认领** —
The durable board rewrote `store.jsonl` from memory on every mutation, so two handles that read
version *n* and both claimed the same row both "succeeded" and the last write silently kept one
owner; concurrent claims on different rows could also drop each other. Every mutation now takes
the board's exclusive lock file, re-reads the store, checks the compare-and-swap guard against
the file, applies, and persists — exactly one claimer wins, the loser gets a version conflict
naming both versions, and no row is lost. A writer killed while holding the lock leaves it
behind; a lock older than the stale window (5 s) is treated as abandoned and removed, so a
crash never wedges the board.
/ 任务板以前每次改动都按内存整份重写 `store.jsonl`：两个句柄读到同一版本后各自认领同一行，两边都"成功"，
后写的静默覆盖前一个归属；两个 worker 同时认领不同行也会互相冲掉。现在每次改动都先拿任务板的独占锁文件、
重读账本、按磁盘上的版本做比较交换、再落盘——认领只有一个赢家，输的一方拿到带两个版本号的冲突错误，
也不会有行被吞。持锁进程被杀会留下锁文件；超过失效窗口（5 秒）的锁按废弃处理并被清掉，崩溃不会把板卡死。
### Added / 新增
- **The task board's file location is now explicit and documented / 任务板的落盘位置变成显式且可查的** —
`taskboardDir()`/`taskboardFile()` resolve the board directory as explicit `dir` →
`GROK_WORKFLOW_TASKBOARD_DIR` → `$DSH_HOME` (else `~/.dsh`) + `taskboards/grok-workflow`, the
same three-step rule the checkpoint recorder uses, and `store.jsonl` is the single file inside
it. The architecture document now states the path, the row schema, the claim protocol and the
crash-recovery rules in one place.
/ `taskboardDir()`/`taskboardFile()` 按「调用方显式目录 → `GROK_WORKFLOW_TASKBOARD_DIR` →
`$DSH_HOME`（否则 `~/.dsh`）+ `taskboards/grok-workflow`」三级规则定位任务板目录，跟存档记录器同一套
规则，目录里只有一个 `store.jsonl`。架构文档把路径、行格式、认领协议与崩溃恢复规则集中写清。
- **The pending queue keeps its order across a restart / 待办队列的顺序跨重启保留** —
Rows are written sorted by id, so reopening a board used to hand back the queue in id order: `task-10` ahead of
`task-9`, `b` ahead of `a`. Every row now carries its own arrival number, assigned under the claim lock and
persisted with the row, so a restarted dispatcher lists pending work in the order it was created. A store
written before the field existed opens unchanged and takes the numbers from its file order — no reordering,
no lost rows.
/ 落盘时行是按 id 排序写的，所以重开一个板会把队列按 id 序交回来：`task-10` 排在 `task-9` 前面、`b` 排在 `a`
前面。现在每一行自带到达号，在认领锁内分配并随行落盘，重启后的大管家仍按创建顺序交出待办。更早写的账本没有这个
字段也能直接打开，按文件序补上编号——不重排、不丢行。
### Fixed / 修复
- **One report's two diagnostics views now say the same thing / 同一份报告的两个诊断视图现在说同一句话** —

Ops opens two machine views of one report while diagnosing: the diagnostics block the tool surface prints, and the machine ledger a delivery carries when that switch is on. They had drifted apart. The ledger showed no dead routes and no per-call child budget at all, it merged this run's own full lane with another run's busy hint under one heading, and the same error read as two different rows because only one view kept the failure category. The ledger now renders the report's own blocks: a dead-route block naming the route, the transport family and the streak; the child-budget line, so a hung child can be told apart from the run's own deadline; two separate overflow headings, one for this run's cap and one for another live run's approximate hint; and error rows that keep the category and the same message bound in both views. A routing entry that recorded only a wait and named no lane is no longer printed as `no lane named`: the report never showed it, and the ledger no longer invents a row for it. The ledger's own length clamp also stopped eating its tail: the closing lines (why the run stopped, and what the watchdog saw) are reserved before an overlong body is cut, so they survive the truncation instead of being the first thing lost. Both new labels are scrubbed from the human answer like every other ledger label.

/ 诊断一份报告时，运维会同时打开两个机器视图：工具界面打印的诊断块，以及交付里打开开关后带的机器台账。这两个视图跑偏了——台账里根本没有死路由，也没有每次子调用的预算，还把「这一轮自己满载」和「另一个 run 说这条忙」并成一个标题，同一条错误在两边读出来是两行不同的字（只有一边留着失败类别）。现在台账渲染的就是报告自己的块：死路由块（写明哪条路、死于哪类传输故障、连续几次）、子调用预算行（这样「子代理挂住」和「整轮时限到了」才区分得开）、两个分开的溢出标题（一个是这一轮自己的上限，一个是另一个在跑的 run 给的大致提示）、以及两边都保留类别和同样长度上限的错误行。只记了等待时间、没点名任何道的路由条目不再印成 `no lane named`：报告从来不显示它，台账也不再为它编一行。台账自己的长度上限也不再吃掉尾巴：收尾那两行（为什么停的、守卫看到了什么）在切掉超长正文之前就预留好了，所以它们不会被截断吞掉。这两个新标签和人话答案里其它台账标签一样会被清理掉。
### Verification and gate / 验证与门禁
- **The release gate stopped failing on a busy machine / 发版门禁不再因为机器忙就红** —

Two gate cases failed intermittently under load: both asserted the moment the background round *started*, while the gate keeps that session's message channel open until the report is actually delivered — so a message arriving inside that window joined the running round instead of being answered by the front desk, and the case failed with a receipt a user would read as a product bug. Both now wait for the round to *land* (report in, channel gone) through a helper that holds its own timer and fails by name after 15 seconds, instead of the 1-second default that was the real fault. Measured before: 15 of 15 runs red on a loaded machine, 10 of 10 for the second case; after: 0 of 10 and 0 of 6 at comparable load. No assertion, timeout, skip or configuration changed, and no plugin behaviour changed — this is the gate, not the product.

/ 门禁里有两条用例在机器有负载时是间歇性红的：两条都在后台轮「刚开始」的时候就断言，而闸门为整轮留着这条会话的插话通道、直到报告真的投递之后才关——落在这段窗口里的消息不会走前台，会被并进正在跑的那一轮，于是用例红出来一句用户会读成产品故障的回执。现在两条都等这一轮「落地」（报告已到、通道已消失），用的帮助函数自己持钟、超 15 秒报具名失败，而不是原来那个 1 秒默认值——那个默认值才是病根。修前实测：负载下 15 次跑 15 次红，第二条用例 10 次跑 10 次红；修后在可比负载下 0 红（10 次、6 次）。断言、超时、跳过、配置一律没动，插件行为一点没变——动的是门禁，不是产品。
- **Measured on a real run: a route that hangs costs one call, and later tasks never pay for it again / 真机复核：挂住的路只按次数付钱，后面的事不再为它买单** —

Before shipping, a five-task run was measured on an isolated home against a route that accepts the request and then never answers, placed ahead of two live routes. The hung route was called three times in the whole run: twice by the first task (its own two attempts), and never again by tasks two through five, which all landed on a live route. Every hung call was settled by the run's own 45-second child budget (44.65–44.93 s at the endpoint, the remainder being the child's own startup) — never left open, never closed by another watchdog. The third call is the transport layer re-sending the first attempt's orphaned request 300 s later, byte-for-byte the same body: that is the provider's client asking again, not this plugin. Two independent rounds produced the same shape. Evidence: `.rsi/evidence/soak-hang-shape-2026-11-24/`.

/ 发版前在一个隔离的家里跑了五个任务的真实轮次，把一条「收下请求就永远不答」的路排在两条活路前面。整轮里那条挂死路只被调用了三次：第一次是任务 1 自己的两次尝试，任务 2 到 5 一次都没打它、全部落在活路；每次挂死的调用都由这一轮自己的 45 秒子调用预算结算（端点侧 44.65–44.93 秒，差额是子代理自己的启动开销），不是永不结算、也不是被别的看门狗收掉。第三次是传输层在 300 秒后把任务 1 那次尝试遗留的孤儿请求原样重发了一次（请求体字节数完全相同）——再问一次的是服务商那边的客户端，不是本插件。两轮独立复现，形状完全一致。证据在 `.rsi/evidence/soak-hang-shape-2026-11-24/`。
### Fixed / 修复
- **A plan is asked for again instead of being given up on / 计划不再因为一次格式错或一次 503 就降级** —

A planning call that came back without a usable plan used to end the run's split immediately: the run degraded to the structural fallback, which can never report the objective as completed, so a child that answered with prose instead of a structured result, or a planning route that refused or hung, cost the whole round its plan. Planning now asks twice more, and neither ask is a retry. A form gap (no structured result, or a plan the shape gate rejects) is re-asked once in the same planning call — the rule the worker and the verifier already followed — with the rejection named in the prompt. A transport death (timeout, dropped connection, a 5xx, a 429 the switch does not keep on its route) re-fires the plan once, on a route this call has not paid for yet: the route that hung is not waited on twice, and with nothing left to try a refusal is repeated once while a hang goes straight to the fallback. The child-call budget now counts those two rescue calls, so a rescued run cannot be aborted at the moment it recovers.

/ 规划调用没有可用计划时，过去整个计划当场作废：整轮退化成结构性兜底，而兜底计划永远不可能报告目标已完成——所以子代理答完只说了话、计划过不了形状闸门、或者规划那条路由拒绝/挂死，代价都是整轮没有计划。现在规划会多问两次，两次都不算重试：格式错（没有结构化结果，或计划过不了形状闸门）在同一次规划调用里重交一次（执行与检查两条腿早就这么做），提示词里写明被拒原因；传输死（超时、连接断开、服务商 5xx、勾选框没留住的 429）换路重打一次，只落在这一腿还没付过的路由上——挂死的那条不会被等第二次，路都试完了遇到拒绝会原路再打一次，遇到挂死才直接落兜底。子调用预算把这两次补救也算进去了，所以被救回的一轮不会在最关键的时刻因为预算上限被掐断。
- **A judge that died of a bad route no longer makes the worker do the job again / 判定那一步死于坏路时，不再让干活的那一步重做一遍** —

When the verifier (or the supervisor) never answered because the route carrying it timed out, dropped the connection, answered 5xx, or answered a 429 that the switch policy moves off, the attempt used to fail and the retry re-ran the WORKER — the expensive leg — even though the work was still there and only the verdict was missing. The run now asks that same judging leg once more inside the same attempt, with the executor result unchanged, so a verdict that never arrived costs one judge call instead of a full redo: no retry is spent, no extra attempt row appears, and the worker's result stays. The gate is the run's own "this route is dead" evidence; a missing structured result keeps its one free form resubmit and is not treated as a death, a judge that actually said "fail" is an answer and is never re-asked, a setup fault still stops the attempt, and a 429 counts only when the switch policy says a rate-limited route should move on — a 429 the switch keeps on its route means "busy now" and stays a plain retry. The attempt row now records when this rescue happened, and the child-call ceiling pays for the extra walk (a worker at most 2 calls per attempt, each judging leg at most 3), with the load-time backstop raised from 600 to 1000 calls per task so every legal chain combination still loads.

/ 检查者（或监督者）那条路超时、连接被断开、回 5xx，或者回了一个「按勾选框策略该换人」的 429 时，它根本没给出判定；过去这一次尝试就算失败，重试会把**干活的那一步**（最贵的那一步）整个重跑一遍——而活是好的，缺的只是一个判定。现在这一轮会在同一次尝试里，把同一个判定步骤再问一次，执行结果原样不动：一个没到手的判定只花一次判定调用，而不是一次全量重做——不消耗重试次数、不多出一条尝试记录、干活的结果留着。闸门用的是这一轮自己的「这条路死了」证据；「没交结构化结果」仍然保留它那一次免费补交、不算死亡；真的判了「不通过」的那是答案、不会再问；配置/预算类的硬故障仍然直接停；429 只在勾选框说「限流就换人」时才算——勾选框把这条件路留着时，429 的意思是「现在忙」，仍然只是普通重试。尝试记录里会写明发生过这条救援，子代理调用上限也把多出来的一趟算进去了（干活的最多 2 趟、每个判定最多 3 趟），载入期的总闸从 600 抬到 1000，所以任何合法链路组合都仍然装得上。
- **A refused key is reported as a refused key, and no longer pays a pointless resend / 密钥被拒就写成密钥被拒，不再白补交一次** —

When the gateway refused a child with 401 or 403, the run recorded it as a formatting mistake and the report only corrected that wording after the last call — and before that, the task had already paid one same-attempt resubmit that the same key was going to refuse again. A refusal (401/403, an unknown model) now travels to the running workflow the same way a transport death does, carrying the provider's own words, so the attempt ends where it should: the task moves on with the real cause on the row, and there is no resend. It still never marks the route as down — a refused key needs a key, not a different route, so the dead-route table keeps its four transport families and this class is deliberately not one of them. A cancellation and a real format gap are untouched: they keep their one free resubmit.

/ 网关用 401 或 403 拒绝子代理时，这一轮过去把它写成「格式不对」，而且报告要等最后一次调用之后才把措辞改回来——在那之前，任务已经为它白付了一次同次补交，而同一个密钥照样会被再拒一次。现在这类拒绝（401/403、模型不存在）和传输层死因走同一条路回到正在跑的工作流，并带着服务商自己的原话，于是这次尝试停在该停的地方：任务换路往下走，失败行写的是真因，也不会再补交。它仍然不会把那条路由记成「这条路挂了」——密钥被拒要的是换 key，不是换路，所以死路由表仍然只收四个传输族，这一类是故意不收的。被取消和真正的格式错一点没动：它们仍然保留那一次免费补交。
> `v0.13.27` is tagged but published no release: its test gate failed on the runner (a timing-sensitive assertion in the new dead-route case), so the fix is test-only and ships here.
> `v0.13.27` 有标签但没发布：它的门禁在远端跑挂了（新增死路由用例里有一条对时序敏感的断言），所以修的是用例，随这一版一起发。
### Changed / 变更
- **A route that keeps failing is tried last, so a task stops paying for a road that is down / 一直失败的那条路排到最后，不再让每件事都为它付一次钱** —

801:   When a model route failed the same kind of transport failure twice in a row — timeout, dropped connection, a 5xx from the provider, or a 429 — the run kept placing calls on it for every later task, spending one child call (and, on a route that hangs instead of refusing, one whole child-call stall) before falling through to a route that worked. The run now remembers those two failures and moves that route behind every live route for the rest of the run; it is never removed from the chain, it is still tried when nothing else is left, and the row disappears the moment it answers again. Only transport families count: a refused key (401/403), a child that never submitted a structured result, and an engine that never started a child say nothing about the route, so they are not evidence. A 429 counts only when the 429 switch says a rate-limited route advances to the next model — with the switch off the route is kept and the task retries on it, so a 429 is "busy now", not "down". When every live route is already at its in-flight cap, a dead route with room takes the call instead of the run waiting for a lane to drain. Each call row in the report now also names the task it was placed for, so a failure row can be read without counting attempts, and the diagnostics ledger gains a `Dead routes` block naming the route, the family that killed it and how many failures in a row it took. Two things had to change for this to hold on a real run, and both are part of this entry: a call that *hangs* counts toward the table even though a hang still does not make the task switch models (it retries with new wording, but the route that hung is demoted for the rest of the run), and a provider death — a 5xx, a dropped connection, a 429 — now reaches the run carrying the cause the child's own session recorded instead of arriving as one anonymous format error that no path could count. A refused key, a genuine format gap and a cancelled run keep that format error, because none of them is evide... (line truncated to 2000 chars)
802:   / 一条模型路由连续两次栽在同一类传输故障上（超时、连接被断开、服务商 5xx、或 429）时，过去这一轮里后面每件事都还会继续往它身上打电话，先付一次子调用（如果它是挂住而不是直接拒绝，还要付一次完整的子调用等待）才落到能用的路上。现在这一轮会记住这两次失败，把它排到所有活着的路后面；它不会被从链里删掉，别的路都试过之后仍然会试它，而且它一旦答上来这行记录就消失。只有传输类的失败算证据：密钥被拒（401/403）、子代理没交结构化结果、引擎根本没把子代理启动起来，这些都不说明这条路有问题，所以不计数。429 只在「429 勾选框说限流就换人」的时候才算——勾选框关掉时这条路会留着、由任务重试它，那时的 429 意思是「现在忙」，不是「挂了」。当所有活着的路都到并发上限、只剩一条死路由有空位时，这一次调用就直接落到死路由上，而不是干等一条道空出来。报告里每条调用现在还会写明它是为哪件事打的，所以一行失败不用数尝试次数也能读；诊断台账多一块 `Dead routes`，写明是哪条路、死于哪类故障、连续失败了几次。要让这条在真机上也成立，还有两件事一起改了，都算在这一条里：**挂死**的那次调用也计数，尽管挂死仍然不会让任务换模型（任务还是改写措辞重试，但那条挂过的路在本轮剩下的时间里被降级）；服务商那边的死因——5xx、连接被断开、429——现在带着子代理自己会话里记下的原因回到这一轮，不再以一个谁也认不出的「格式不对」出现。密钥被拒、真正的格式错、被取消的 run 仍然保留那个格式错，因为它们都不说明这条路有问题。

804: ## [0.13.26] - 2026-11-24
805: 
806: ### Fixed / 修复
807: 
808: - **A child that died is no longer reported as a formatting mistake / 子代理死掉不再被写成"格式不对"** —
809:   When a child agent timed out, hit a refused key or was cancelled, the report used to record it as a format error and say the child "returned no valid structured result", which reads as "send it again" — the workflow engine hands the script the same empty value for a dead child as for a child that answered without submitting. Measured: 530 transport, auth and timeout deaths were filed as format errors against 25 real ones. The plugin now records what each child actually ended as and rewrites only the rows whose evidence is unambiguous: a death is named as a death with the cause the provider gave, in the provider's own words, and a child that genuinely finished without submitting keeps its format error and its one free resubmit, which is the case that rescue path exists for. A run whose children died of different causes keeps each child's own cause — measured on a live run: four workers killed by a refused key were named as such while a planner that really did fail to format its result kept its format error. Where nothing was recorded the report says the child ended abnormally and that the cause is unknown, instead of inventing a missing form. The delivered answer's "still incomplete" lines are rebuilt from the repaired rows, so the sentence a user reads names the same cause as the report. The memory archive names the cause too, instead of only saying the transcript was empty. The cause is read from the child's own session log, which is where it actually lives: the engine's in-process subagent result has no provider diagnostic field at all, and reading the prompt out of the wrong spec shape had left the whole repair inactive on every real run.
810:   / 子代理超时、密钥被拒、或者被取消时，报告过去一律写成"格式不对"，理由是"子代理没有返回有效的结构化结果"——这句话读起来像"再发一次就好"，而引擎交给脚本的其实对"死掉的子代理"和"答了但没提交的子代理"是同一个空值。实测：530 次传输、鉴权、超时被写成格式错，真正的格式错只有 25 次。现在插件会记下每个子代理真实的结束状态，只改写证据没有歧义的那些行：死掉就写成死掉，并带上服务商给的原因、用它自己的原话；真的"答完了但没提交"的子代理仍然保留格式错，也仍然保留那一次免费补交——那条救援路本来就是为它准备的。一个 run 里子代理死因各不相同的话，每个子代理各按自己的死因写——真机实测过：四个被拒密钥打死的执行子代理如实写成鉴权失败，而一个确实没把结果格式写对的规划子代理仍然保留格式错。什么都没记下来的时候，报告说"子代理异常结束、原因未知"，不再编一个"少交了表格"的理由。交付给你看的那句「仍未完成」也跟着按修好的行重建，所以你读到的句子和报告说的是同一个原因。记忆归档同样会写死因，不再只说"它的对话记录是空的"。死因是从子代理自己的会话记录里读出来的——它本来就只在那里：引擎在本机进程内跑子代理时交回的结果里根本没有服务商的失败原文，而原先又把提示词读错了形状，于是这套修复在真机上一直等于没装。

812: ## [0.13.25] - 2026-11-24
813: 
814: ### Fixed / 修复
815: 
816: - **One stray quote in a verdict no longer costs the whole task / 一个跑偏的引号不再让整件事重做** —
817:   When a verifier or a supervisor wrote an unescaped English double quote inside its structured result, the host could not parse it and handed the workflow an empty value, so a judgement that was really "pass" was discarded and the task was redone from the start — a measured 19.5 minutes burned for one character. Both judging roles now get the same one-shot, same-attempt resubmit the worker already had: the same verdict and the same evidence re-sent in a form that parses, without spending a retry. The prompts and the result schema now ask for quote-safe, short prose (English double quotes written as 「」 or single quotes; every evidence and finding item under 800 characters), an empty structured result names the role that lost it and the channel, and the host's JSON wording (`structured_output`, `Expected ','...`) is classified as a format error instead of an unknown provider fault. The child-call ceiling counts the resubmit, so the rescue can never trip the budget instead of recovering the verdict.
818:   / 检查者或监督者交回的结论里只要有一个没转义的英文双引号，宿主就解析失败、把空值交给工作流，于是一个本来是"通过"的判定被丢掉，整件事从头再做一遍——实测一个字符烧掉 19.5 分钟。现在这两个判定角色和干活的子代理一样，在同一次尝试内可以补交一次：同样的判定、同样的证据，用能解析的写法重发，不消耗重试次数。提示词和结果结构现在要求短句、安全引号（英文双引号写成「」或单引号，每条证据和发现 800 字内）；空的结构结果会点名是哪个角色、哪个通道丢的；宿主那句 JSON 原话（`structured_output`、`Expected ','` 等）算作格式错误，不再当成来源故障。子代理调用上限把补交算进去了，所以这条救援路不会被预算卡死。
819: 
820: ### Changed / 变更
821: 
822: - **The final answer is written for you, not read off the ledger / 结论是写给你看的，不是把台账念一遍** —
823:   A finished run used to arrive as a 200-character status strip and only its first sentence, with `答案：` / `下一步：` labels and the same paragraph mirrored in Chinese and English. The delivery now carries the run's whole summary, names what was achieved and where the deliverable is (its path is no longer stripped out of the block), and asks the answering model to rewrite that material against the question you actually asked — in your language only. A failed run still hands over its wording verbatim: a paraphrase is free to soften, and a failure that reads like an answer is worse than no answer.
824:   / 以前跑完收到的是一条 200 字左右的台账摘要，而且只有第一句，外面还套着「答案：」「下一步：」这些标签，同一段话中英各来一遍。现在交出去的原料是整个结论、做成了什么、以及东西放在哪里（交付物路径不再被当成机器细节删掉），并要求作答的模型按你真正问的问题把这份原料重写成一句话说得清的回答——只用你说的一种语言。失败仍然是逐字转达：改写有软化的自由，而一个读起来像答案的失败比没有答案更糟。
825: 
826: - **The synthesizer may write 结果 / 怎么用 / 注意, and it rewrites the caveats itself / 汇总可以写「结果/怎么用/注意」三段，注意事项由它自己写** —
827:   The narrative was capped at 200 characters with no headings and no lists, and the report's open questions were pasted under it word for word — so the answer read like a status line followed by the machine's own notes. It may now use those three sections (no other headings, no lists, no markdown), the narrative bound follows the answer's size, and the open items are rewritten in its own words under the caveat section. lines.text: When a model route failed the same kind of transport failure twice in a row — timeout, dropped connection, a 5xx from the provider, or a 429 — the run kept placing calls on it for every later task, spending one child call (and, on a route that hangs instead of refusing, one whole child-call stall) before falling through to a route that worked. The run now remembers those two failures and moves that route behind every live route for the rest of the run; it is never removed from the chain, it is still tried when nothing else is left, and the row disappears the moment it answers again. Only transport families count: a refused key (401/403), a child that never submitted a structured result, and an engine that never started a child say nothing about the route, so they are not evidence. A 429 counts only when the 429 switch says a rate-limited route advances to the next model — with the switch off the route is kept and the task retries on it, so a 429 is "busy now", not "down". When every live route is already at its in-flight cap, a dead route with room takes the call instead of the run waiting for a lane to drain. Each call row in the report now also names the task it was placed for, so a failure row can be read without counting attempts, and the diagnostics ledger gains a `Dead routes` block naming the route, the family that killed it and how many failures in a row it took. Two things had to change for this to hold on a real run, and both are part of this entry: a call that *hangs* counts toward the table even though a hang still does not make the task switch models (it retries with new wording, but the route that hung is demoted for the rest of the run), and a provider death — a 5xx, a dropped connection, a 429 — now reaches the run carrying the cause the child's own session recorded instead of arriving as one anonymous format error that no path could count.
